name: Multi-Isosurface Rendering
definition: IR renders a surface in 3D space that intersects voxels having a constant value (isosurface), similar to a 2D isocontour.
summary: Multi-Isosurface Rendering extracts explicit triangle meshes at uniformly chosen isovalue thresholds to visualize distinct material boundaries, differing from single-isosurface methods by enabling interactive exploration of multiple internal structures simultaneously.
